articles.author: Tim Ross
articles.title: US to seek Putin’s ‘blessing’ for Europe to join Ukraine talks - POLITICO.eu
articles.description: After two days of talks in Abu Dhabi, Russia and Ukraine have agreed a major prisoner swap, with final numbers to be confirmed, U.S. officials say.
articles.content:
ABU DHABI U.S. officials will head to Moscow in person on Thursday to ask Russia’s Vladimir Putin to give his “blessing” to allowing European representatives to join future peace talks for Ukraine.
